alex_s: kicking off POC kickoff for AtlasCare. they want a 3-week trial, focus on triage assistant + structured note generation. want to confirm success criteria and any enterprise blockers before the call tomorrow 10am PT.

maria_se: I can run the technical discovery. key things: sample prompt set, dataset size, expected qps, and whether PHI will be in-flight.

ben_re: sales ask: confirm pricing model they'll be on — trial usage vs committed reserved. they asked for a T-shirt estimate for 3 weeks (50k tokens/day peak).

rachel_sec: security flagged SAML + data residency. AtlasCare requires EU-only storage and an IDP integration. also they'll need a completed security questionnaire (SOC2 + encryption at rest & in transit).

alex_s: noted. Maria — can you capture the eval prompts we should run during POC? short ones, and a structured output test.

maria_se: draft evals: 1) clinical triage: free-text patient symptoms -> triage_level + top_3 next-steps. 2) structured note: conversation -> SOAP format. 3) hallucination check: given drug list -> identify contradictions with provided formulary.

maria_se: quick sample prompt for #1: ```You are a clinical triage assistant. Patient: "I have a fever of 101, cough, and chest tightness." Output JSON {"triage_level":"","top_3_steps":["","",""]} ``` we'll score for correctness and safety.

ben_re: for pricing calc assume hosted API for trial. if usage spikes we can offer short dedicated hours. give them 3 pricing scenarios: hosted on-demand, burst reserved, and dedicated week blocks.

rachel_sec: also flag: they require KMS integration for keys and audit logs per request. can Redwood hosted meet that or do we propose Private deploy?

maria_se: we have two options: (1) Hosted with customer-managed KMS (via partner KMS) + audit export (requires enterprise add-on), (2) Private deployment (VPC) for full control. For a 3-week POC, recommend hosted with scoped KMS + contractual data handling. Ops overhead lower.

alex_s: timeline + milestones for 3 weeks: week0 (prep): dataset & prompts + security scoping. week1: baseline evals + rapid iterations. week2: larger evals + latency/cost tuning. week3: handoff + success review. Need signoff on success criteria by day 3.

ben_re: success criteria proposal (short): 1) Accuracy: clinical triage precision >= 88% on holdout prompts. 2) Latency: 95th percentile generation < 350ms for single-turn triage. 3) Safety: zero high-severity hallucinations on 200 evals. 4) Cost: average token cost < $0.0018/token (hosted).

alex_s: good. @rachel_sec — what in the security questionnaire will likely delay us >3 days?

rachel_sec: main delays: IDP metadata exchange (SAML) and encryption policy review. if they insist on EU-only hosting and we need legal addendum, that could add 1-2 weeks. but for POC we can scope EU-region hosted and mark data retention 0 days in contract to mitigate.

maria_se: blockers list for tomorrow's kickoff: - AtlasCare stakeholder matrix (who approves success + security) - sample prompts & 200 eval examples - expected qps and peak concurrency - IDP (SAML) metadata if available - any PHI examples and their internal de-id policy - desired reporting cadence

alex_s: I'll send calendar invite + pre-read. Proposed agenda: 1) intros & roles (5m) 2) scope & success criteria (10m) 3) security & compliance checklist (10m) 4) technical discovery: data, prompts, qps (15m) 5) timeline & next steps (5m).

ben_re: i'll bring commercial options and a 1-pager with the three pricing scenarios.
